skills.name: bayesian-workflow
skills.description: The Gelman/Vehtari/McElreath Bayesian workflow: iterative model building, fake-data simulation, checking, expansion, and reporting.

skills.name: stan-modeling
skills.description: Writing Stan programs and fitting them with CmdStanPy/cmdstanr: blocks, types, parameterization, common model patterns, and ArviZ/posterior integration.

skills.name: stan-priors
skills.description: Prior specification for Stan models: weakly informative defaults, scaling rules, prior predictive checks, tail behavior, and power-scaling sensitivity.

skills.name: stan-computation
skills.description: Fitting and diagnosing HMC/NUTS in Stan: warmup, chains, ESS/MCSE, divergences, reparameterization, failure modes, and approximate algorithms.

skills.name: stan-model-evaluation
skills.description: Posterior predictive checks, PSIS-LOO cross-validation, Pareto k, LOO-PIT, model comparison, stacking, and projection predictive selection.

skills.name: applied-regression
skills.description: Regression and Other Stories in Stan: interpreting coefficients as comparisons, transformations, GLMs, fake-data simulation, poststratification, and causal regression.

skills.name: stan-testing
skills.description: Statistical modeling as software development: parameter recovery tests, simulation-based calibration, pytest/testthat harnesses for Stan programs, reproducibility.

skills.name: r-stan-interfaces
skills.description: The R Stan stack: cmdstanr, rstanarm, brms, posterior, bayesplot, loo, priorsense, projpred — fitting, prior control, prediction, and diagnostics from R.
